bangkok.detail: Headline -7.5 cm LOS in 108 days implies roughly 10x the published recent rates (about 0.9 cm/yr on average, locally above 2 cm/yr, Sentinel-1 PS-InSAR 2016-2019; 1-3 cm/yr in 2005-2010 InSAR); the headline series has +/-4-5 cm steps in both directions, typical of tropical decorrelation.
